rows.label: Basic tariff: taxable income above CHF 412,000
rows.note: Le revenu supérieur à 412.000 francs est imposé à 13,86%.
rows.source_title: AFC/ESTV Feuille cantonale Neuchâtel (Etat: février 2026), impôt sur le revenu: calcul de l'impôt, art. 40b quater LCdir (tax periods 2024 to 2026)

rows.label: Rounding (art. 40b al. 4)
rows.value: Taxable income is rounded down to the CHF 100
rows.source_title: AFC/ESTV Feuille cantonale Neuchâtel (Etat: février 2026), impôt sur le revenu: calcul de l'impôt, art. 40b quater LCdir (tax periods 2024 to 2026)

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Neuchâtel; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Neuchâtel; other communes in Neuchâtel set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.label: Profit tax rate, profit up to CHF 5 million
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.
rows.source_title: AFC/ESTV Feuille cantonale Neuchâtel (Etat février 2026), personnes morales: calcul de l'impôt, Art. 94 LCdir

rows.label: What it covers
rows.value: Investment property of natural and legal persons, real estate of pension institutions and of public bodies
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)
